description: Lumped-capacitance transient shell-and-tube HX (TEMA E, 1 shell / 2 tube passes). The flow path is discretised into N control volumes; each CV holds a hot-stream, cold-stream and wall energy-balance ODE integrated with scipy.solve_ivp. The steady-state limit reproduces the ε-NTU heat duty of the F1a model.

unit.name: Generic 1-shell, 2-tube-pass shell-and-tube HX (water-water, TEMA E)
unit.source: Incropera & DeWitt (2006), Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th ed., ch.11; Kakac & Liu (2002), Heat Exchangers: Selection, Rating, and Thermal Design, 2nd ed., CRC Press; Roetzel & Xuan (1999), Dynamic Behaviour of Heat Exchangers, WIT Press.

U.note: Overall heat-transfer coefficient, water-water shell-and-tube (reused from F1a)

A.note: Total external tube heat-transfer area (reused from F1a)

cp_hot.note: Liquid water specific heat at ~25-50 degC. Source: NIST/IAPWS-IF97; Incropera Table A.6 (c_p = 4.179-4.186 kJ/kgK over 25-50 degC)

cp_cold.note: Liquid water specific heat. Source: NIST/IAPWS-IF97; Incropera Table A.6

rho_hot.note: Liquid water density at ~40 degC. Source: NIST/IAPWS-IF97; Incropera Table A.6 (rho=992.1 kg/m3 at 313 K)

rho_cold.note: Liquid water density at ~20 degC. Source: NIST/IAPWS-IF97; Incropera Table A.6 (rho=998.0 kg/m3 at 293 K)

cp_wall.note: Specific heat of carbon/stainless steel tube wall. Source: Incropera Table A.1 (AISI 304 ~ 477 J/kgK; carbon steel ~ 434-490 J/kgK), rounded to 500

m_wall.note: Total metal mass of the tube bundle (thermal mass)

n_cv.note: Number of control volumes along the flow path. The well-mixed (upwind) cell chain converges first-order to the continuous counter-flow epsilon-NTU limit; N=60 keeps the steady-state duty within ~1.3% of the closed-form value while staying fast (<20 ms for a 300 s transient).
